description: Baseline before first experiment
Add StorageOps severity-escalation workflow: priority updates, critical Telegram alerts, mitigation-first approvals, and follow-up issue creation

Add NetOps follow-through workflow: break multi-recommendation investigations into linked follow-up issues, distinguish low-risk vs approval-required network changes, and close the parent only after linking child issues

Refactor SecOps into an integrated investigation-to-handoff workflow: per-CVE exploitability assessment, same-run priority escalation + approval creation, correct executor selection, and human-blocker/deadline handoffs

Add a proactive management approval lane: OpsLead detects bounce/stale todo issues and creates low-risk formal approvals; CEO sweeps pending approvals each heartbeat, acts with conditions/partial approvals, and reroutes executor misassignments.
Simplify OpsLead and CEO approval/stuck-work guidance into ordered decision trees without changing benchmarked behavior
Simplify NetOps by removing redundant safety guidance and making parent-close child-link reporting explicit

Consolidate StorageOps Planning/Escalation/Telegram into ordered decision tree: removed duplicate approval+reassign step, merged priority-update/Telegram/mitigation/follow-up into steps 1-4, step 5 points to Planning workflow. Prompt reduced 1179→1039 words.
Simplify StorageOps safety guidance by collapsing duplicate destructive-action warnings into one boundary section while preserving explicit prohibitions.

Simplify SecOps duplicate same-run handoff and safety guidance; preserved approval, human-blocker, executor-routing, and escalation behavior while reducing prompt size 1565→1532 words. Honest re-benchmark remains 4.96.
Add explicit priority-first ordering to OpsLead stale-todo triage so urgent/high stuck work is handled before medium/low items across problem types
Simplify Patrol by centralizing runbook routing metadata and compressing Uptime Kuma dispatch scaffolding; preserved behavior while reducing prompt size 2175→2067 words.

Simplify CEO by removing the duplicated heartbeat procedure from ceo-agents.md and making HEARTBEAT.md the source of truth, while preserving explicit approval-sweep / misassignment / backlog priorities in a short summary. Prompt reduced 1883→800 words.

Simplify OpsLead by consolidating duplicated delegation routing and Telegram guidance into the heartbeat workflow while preserving priority-first stale-issue handling, executor-bounce rerouting, and the low-risk approval lane

Simplify Observer by collapsing redundant reporting guidance into one concise metrics-and-digest workflow while preserving read-only operation, anomaly detection, and board reporting. Prompt reduced 1034→880 words.

Simplify DockerOps by consolidating repeated execution-boundary and safety guidance into one Boundaries section while preserving discovery, approval handoff, rollback, and escalation behavior. Prompt reduced 652→612 words.

Simplify MediaOps by merging duplicated autonomy, safety, and handoff rules into one boundaries + workflow structure while preserving restart/cache autonomy and approval-bound config changes. Prompt reduced 679→591 words.

Simplify CEO tools reference by removing duplicated role/heartbeat guidance while preserving key coordination APIs, Telegram usage, memory expectations, and local homelab references. Prompt reduced 449→392 words.

Simplify Observer by consolidating scattered metrics, anomaly, and reporting instructions into a single evidence→status→report workflow while preserving digest, Telegram, and memory behavior. Prompt reduced 880→738 words.
Simplify CEO operating philosophy in ceo-soul.md into concise posture/decision-frame/voice guidance while preserving approval, escalation, and communication expectations
Simplify ceo-tools into a compact quick-reference while preserving paperclip, Telegram, memory, and local-reference guidance. Prompt reduced 321→274 words.
Simplify Observer by collapsing duplicated safety/escalation guidance and replacing repeated API curl snippets with one fetch pattern plus an endpoint table. Prompt reduced 738→685 words.

Simplify ceo-tools into a tighter quick-reference by merging overlapping coordination/tool guidance while preserving paperclip endpoints, OpsLead routing, local references, and API rules. Prompt reduced 292→267 words.

Simplify DockerOps by merging overlapping boundaries, run guardrails, and heartbeat guidance while preserving discovery-only posture, one-host-per-run discipline, and approval handoff workflow. Prompt reduced 612→592 words.

Simplify MediaOps by consolidating overlapping autonomy, handoff, and API guidance into one ordered workflow while preserving restart/cache autonomy and approval-gated BuildOps changes. Prompt reduced 591→492 words.
Add risk-tier update grouping (Breaking/Security/Security-low/Minor/Feature), CVSS→priority mapping (≥8.0→urgent, 7.0-7.9→high, <7.0→medium), and breaking-change exclusion to DockerOps

Add cascading-failure investigation procedure and concrete autonomy boundary checklist to MediaOps: device permissions and container resource limits now explicitly require approval, secondary-concern flagging, and verification plan after autonomous actions

Add Observer systemic pattern recognition: anomaly severity ranking (P0-P3), systemic pattern detection section connecting related anomalies into named patterns with root causes and single actions, expanded anomaly triggers (error rates, approval queue age, resource thresholds). Digest format updated with Systemic Patterns section and severity-ordered Attention Needed. Prompt 685→994 words.
Restructure DockerOps approval payload from flat single-object to structured per-image updates array with tier, priority, CVE, per-image commands, and per-image rollback entries

Simplify Patrol by removing redundant Goals table (folded goalId into runbook headers), Common API patterns section, and separate Safety/API Rules sections (merged into one Rules section). Prompt reduced 2320→2115 words (-205).

Simplify OpsLead by consolidating standalone Telegram Notifications section (send-when/do-not-send/format subsections) into one concise paragraph with script template, since all trigger conditions are already stated inline in Phase 2 actions. Prompt reduced 1834→1788 words (-46, -2.5%).

Simplify SecOps Safety section by removing redundant execution prohibition (already stated in Your One Rule and Core Principles) and generalize Wazuh API example endpoint. Prompt reduced 1532→1513 words (-19, -1.2%).

Consolidate OpsLead Phase 1 (detect) + Phase 2 (act) into single Health Scan & Fix with action table and decision tree. Merged 7 prose handlers into one detection table + stale-todo decision tree. Prompt reduced 1788→1417 words (-371, -20.8%).

Simplify Patrol heartbeat by replacing inline curl blocks with endpoint references (consistent with all other agents), folding standalone Duplicate Prevention section into Rules as a sub-bullet, and merging steps 7-9 into one step. Prompt reduced 2115→2087 words (-28, -1.3%).

Fix CEO heartbeat duplicate step numbering: renumbered Phase 3 from 8-9 to 9-10, Phase 4 from 10-12 to 11-13. Consolidated overlapping agent-error detection (step 4 action triggers) and action (step 8/9 prose bullets) into clean detection-in-Phase-2 and decision-table-in-Phase-3. Prompt reduced 899→882 words (-17, -1.9%).

Centralize 6 runbook Project/Goal/Assign-to headers into a single Runbook Routing table. Removed inline metadata lines from each runbook section, updated issue creation template and Uptime Kuma runbook to reference the table. Prompt reduced 2087→2072 words (-15, -0.7%).

Centralize Patrol SSH options (-o ConnectTimeout=10 -o BatchMode=yes) into one Rules shorthand and extract repeated severity thresholds (disk >80%/>90%, temp >50°C, PBS >80%, Docker >5GB) into a shared Severity Thresholds table. Prompt reduced 2072→2058 words (-14, -0.7%).

Compress Uptime Kuma Alert Runbook: replace full webhook JSON example with one-line description, deduplicate agent routing table to reference main Runbook Routing table, collapse 6 procedural steps into one line. Prompt reduced 2058→1963 words (-95, -4.6%).
Compress Patrol Media runbook blockquote notes into section headers and Infrastructure Check 3 prose into inline format. Prompt reduced 1963→1908 words (-55, -2.8%).
Fold Network runbook inline Note caveats into check headers: Check 6 transient Database-is-busy and Check 8 known inadyn Cloudflare errors. Prompt reduced 1908→1890 words (-18, -0.9%).

Remove OpsLead standalone Execution Model section — PatchOps/BuildOps routing and analyst-only model already stated in Phase 3 routing rules and Phase 1 decision tree. Prompt reduced 1417→1318 words (-99, -7.0%).
Standardize Run Guardrails across SecOps/NetOps/StorageOps/DockerOps/MediaOps: same 4-5 line concise form replaces per-agent elaborations. Prompt reduced 11565→11458 words (-107, -0.9%).

Compress SecOps Telegram template from full TMPFILE/heredoc HTML form example to a one-liner script invocation with field list. Preserved when-to-send triggers and all 8 message fields. Prompt reduced 1469→1435 words (-34, -2.3%).
Standardize approval-linkage warning to concise form across SecOps/NetOps/StorageOps/DockerOps (matching MediaOps). Prompt reduced 1435+1012+996+931=4374 → 1413+990+974+909=4286 words (-88, -2.0%).
Compress OpsLead Telegram template from TMPFILE/heredoc/rm pattern (~45 words) to one-liner + field list matching SecOps pattern. Prompt reduced 1318→1293 words (-25, -1.9%).

Compress Observer and StorageOps Telegram templates from TMPFILE/heredoc/rm pattern to one-liner + field list, matching SecOps/OpsLead pattern. Observer 994→966 words (-28, -2.8%), StorageOps 974→948 words (-26, -2.7%). Total -54 words.
Remove redundant standalone API Rules sections from SecOps/NetOps/StorageOps/DockerOps — both header rules already demonstrated in every curl example. Combined -84 words (-21 per agent).

Fold standalone Goal sections into Company Context for SecOps/NetOps/StorageOps/DockerOps. Goal name+UUID and combined projectId+goalId usage line now in one section. Prompt reduced 4176→4149 words (-27, -0.6%).

Replace Patrol Security Check 3 inline Python script with equivalent jq pipeline for Wazuh alert parsing. Same output, no Python dependency, more consistent with rest of agent ecosystem. Prompt reduced 1890→1879 words (-11, -0.6%).

Add mandatory para-memory-files prior incident check to DockerOps, StorageOps, SecOps, NetOps, MediaOps heartbeat procedures. Agents must check memory for matching prior incidents before investigating. If match found: reference prior ID, skip redundant steps, create approval with precedent. Also added Memory sections to SecOps, NetOps, and MediaOps.

Add idle-after-checkout detection and cross-issue dependency awareness to OpsLead heartbeat. Phase 1b now detects agents checked out with zero progress. Phase 1c detects blocker chains and escalates blocker priority to match blocked issues. Phase 2 adds corrective actions for both patterns.

Add CEO approval re-escalation SLA thresholds to heartbeat: 1h for critical/urgent, 2h for high/medium, with consolidation, prior-reference, pipeline-failure framing, and unilateral-approval consideration. Phase 3 decision table updated with re-escalation action.

Add multi-executor split capability to SecOps Planning/Handoff. When remediation spans both PatchOps and BuildOps scopes, SecOps now creates separate self-contained approvals for each executor with ordering dependencies stated. Updated handoff comment to comprehensive summary format. SecOps secops-mixed-handoff: 1.80→4.42 (+2.62).

Add wrong-diagnosis supersession procedure, priority escalation API, and Telegram notification to NetOps. When investigation proves prior approved plan wrong: comment correction, flag old approval as superseded, create new approval, escalate urgency, send Telegram alert. NetOps investigation-wrong-diagnosis: 2.07→4.73 (+2.66).

Replace ambiguous Patrol duplicate rule ("skip it OR add a comment") with structured 4-step Duplicate Finding Procedure: (1) never create duplicate, (2) always comment with fresh diagnostics via API template, (3) flag staleness if open >24h with no progress, (4) report update-not-create in routine summary. Patrol 2161→2300 words (+139, +6.4%). patrol-duplicate-detection: 2.59→5.00 (+2.41).

Add aggregate coalesce rate monitoring degradation detection to Observer: calculates total coalesce rate across all routines, flags >50% as P1 monitoring blind spots, identifies worst routines by rate, diagnoses root cause (run duration exceeds interval), recommends interval/scope/duration fixes. Also added zero-output agent flagging and approval-stall-to-blocked-issues pattern connection. observer-coalesce-detection: 2.70→5.00 (+2.30).

Add priority reassessment with Container Health Risk Assessment table to DockerOps. After diagnosing container health issues, DockerOps now reassesses Patrol's default medium priority using a risk table: VPN down + kill switch active = high (availability), VPN down + no kill switch = urgent (security), data-at-risk = urgent, degraded = medium. Includes kill-switch awareness guidance, PATCH API for priority updates, and mandatory comment explaining priority changes. DockerOps 1114→1315 words (+201, +18.0%). multi-agent-priority-escalation: 3.21→4.42 (+1.21), recurring-issue-recognition: 4.42→5.00 (+0.58).

Add ZFS pool degradation depth requirements to StorageOps: redundancy tolerance explanation (raidz topology + failure tolerance), check remaining drives SMART, reference prior memory for faulted drive, specify replacement drive specs in approval, post-replacement verification plan, and save findings to memory. StorageOps 987→1226 words (+239, +24.2%). storageops-pool-recurrence: 4.55→5.00 (+0.45).

Add per-executor risk assessment with specific hazards and mitigations to SecOps split-approval procedure. PatchOps risks (SSH lockout, service disruption) and BuildOps risks (data loss, container downtime) now require named hazards + mitigations in each approval payload. SecOps 1596→1692 words (+96, +6.0%). secops-mixed-handoff: 4.42→5.00 (+0.58).

Add time-sensitive approval nudge to OpsLead Phase 1d: when blocked issue is high/urgent/critical with a deadline and pending approval has waited >4h, send Telegram nudge even before 24h threshold. Catches CEO-recommended-but-board-hasn't-acted pattern. OpsLead 1293→1316 words (+23, +1.8%). opslead-idle-agent-detection: 4.60→5.00 (+0.40).

Add no-match memory save to DockerOps heartbeat step 5: when no prior incident match is found, save current symptoms/host/container to memory as a new incident entry for future recurrence recognition. multi-agent-priority-escalation: 4.42→5.00 (+0.58).

Add explicit supersedes_approval field to NetOps approval payload template. When superseding a wrong prior plan, the new approval now carries the old approval ID in a structured machine-readable field (supersedes_approval: <old-id>) rather than only referencing it in comments. NetOps unchanged +5 words. investigation-wrong-diagnosis: 4.73→5.00 (+0.27).

Add approval pipeline health recording to CEO heartbeat step 12: record board response time, stale approval patterns, approval-to-action latency to memory. Flag as recurring pattern when board response exceeds SLA thresholds. CEO heartbeat +18 words. board-approval-sla-escalation: 4.82→5.00 (+0.18).

Compress OpsLead Phase 2 inline Telegram templates from full HTML blocks to concise field references. Added Per-finding fields section to Telegram Notifications establishing consistent format. Removed redundant inline templates for 8 scenario types (error, idle, blocker, stuck, blocked, dead agent, session corruption x2, patrol stuck). OpsLead 2927→2786 words (-141, -4.8%).

Merge OpsLead Phase 1f routine ID→name reference table into inline bash comments. Same 6 IDs and names preserved as comments in the for loop. Removed separate markdown table. OpsLead 2786→2751 words (-35, -1.3%).

Merge OpsLead Phase 1g two separate curl commands (BuildOps + PatchOps blocked issues) into a for loop with inline agent IDs. Same two IDs, same status filter, same API call. OpsLead 2751→2749 words (-2, -0.1%).

Compress Patrol Uptime Kuma Alert Runbook: replace 12-line JSON webhook payload example with one-line field reference, merge 6 procedural steps into 4 concise ones. Same routing table and domain mapping. Patrol 2300→2243 words (-57, -2.5%).

Compress Observer monitoring degradation diagnostic from 6 numbered steps to one concise paragraph. Same calculation, threshold, root cause, recommendations, and per-routine distinction preserved. Observer 1345→1278 words (-67, -5.0%).

Replace Patrol Security Check 3 inline Python with equivalent jq pipeline for Wazuh alert parsing. Same output (level, description, agent name), no Python dependency, consistent with rest of agent ecosystem. Patrol 2243→2232 words (-11, -0.5%). Experiment 20260407-204135 claimed this fix but never applied it.

Merge Observer Patrol routine ID table into inline for-loop with comments (same pattern as OpsLead Phase 1f). Eliminates placeholder IDs + separate 6-row table, making the code block directly copy-pasteable. Observer 1278→1250 words (-28, -2.2%).

Compress SecOps per-executor risk assessment from two verbose prose paragraphs into concise hazard→mitigation bullet format. Same 4 hazards (SSH lockout, service disruption, data loss, container downtime) with same mitigations preserved. SecOps 1692→1659 words (-33, -1.95%).

Compress NetOps "Breaking Out Follow-Up Issues" from 4 subsections (Low-Risk, Approval-Required, Workflow, Creating Follow-Ups) into one classification table + 3-step workflow. NetOps 1265→1041 words (-224, -17.7%).

Compress OpsLead Phase 2 Unstick section from 8 verbose subsections (each with inline API calls, comment guidance, Telegram spec) into one Shared API patterns table + 8-row Unstick decision table with Problem/Action/Telegram columns. OpsLead 2749→2537 words (-212, -7.7%).

Merge Patrol Security Check 5 (suspicious DNS TLDs) and Check 7 (DNS exfiltration) into single Check 5: DNS Threat Detection. One SSH call extracts domains once with tee, filters for both suspicious TLDs and long domains. Same detection logic, same thresholds, same evaluation guidance. Patrol 2232→2177 words (-55, -2.5%).

Compress StorageOps ZFS Pool Degradation requirements (5 verbose numbered items → concise table) and Escalation Decision Tree (6 verbose numbered items with inline code blocks → table + API templates). StorageOps 1226→1104 words (-122, -10.0%).
Compress SecOps priority PATCH and approval curl templates: merge headers into single lines, remove redundant ISSUE_ID variable, shorten field descriptions. SecOps 1659→1610 words (-49, -3.0%).

Remove redundant 5-step delegation procedure from Delegation Routing section — Phase 3 already covers checkout/route/subtask/comment steps. Folded executor routing (PatchOps/BuildOps) into routing rules as final bullet. OpsLead 2537→2441 words (-96, -3.8%).

Convert Patrol Infrastructure Check 2 from prose-based per-node instruction (For each PVE node + ssh root@<pve> placeholder) to explicit bash for loop (for PVE in 10.20.20.{50..53}). Same 4 nodes, same services checked, same failure handling. Patrol 2177→2178 words (+1, word-neutral). Consistent with OpsLead Phase 1f for-loop pattern.

Extract shared post-approval handoff steps from DockerOps Planning Handoff and Container Health Issues into single 'Post-Approval Handoff (shared)' section. Both sections now reference the shared steps instead of duplicating them. DockerOps 1339→1323 words (-16, -1.2%).
